title: Request frame
description:
Initiated by either side, expects exactly one response carrying the same `id` (spec §4.1).

Both peers may send requests at any time. There is no client and no server at this layer — see the `symmetry` note in the repository README.

method.title: Method name
method.description: See methods/index.json for the v1 inventory. An unknown method must be answered with `protocol.unsupported`, never ignored — the caller is blocked on a response.

params.title: Method parameters
params.description: Shape is determined by `method`. Absent is equivalent to `{}`.
